name: core-portraits
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production-ready game portrait atlas for Lantern Journey, a warm seaside 2D fantasy RPG. Beautiful charming hand-drawn 1990s Japanese RPG character art, rich expressive eyes, clean delicate ink lines, fine painterly cel shading, restrained golden light, navy background. NOT 3D, NOT photographs, NOT pixel sprites, NOT chibi. Every person unmistakably adult with mature facial proportions. Absolutely no text, letters, borders, gutters, watermark or labels. Perfect uniform grid filling the whole image edge to edge. Each head stays safely inside its cell and the center of each face is aligned to the center of its cell. No anatomy crosses cell boundaries. EXACTLY 4 ROWS AND 3 COLUMNS, twelve equal cells, portrait canvas aspect 3:4 (1536x2048 preferred). Chest-up portraits on identical flat dark navy backdrops. Reference image 1 contains animated sprites of Allen row1, Mina row2, Rio row3; reference image2 final character is Noah. Preserve their recognizable hair, colors, clothes and gender. ROW1 ALLEN: adult man age24 chestnut tousled hair teal eyes, teal traveling cloak fastened with gold clasp, cream shirt. ROW2 MINA: adult woman age24 auburn red ponytail green eyes, forest-green ranger cloak leather archer clothes. ROW3 RIO: adult man age25 silver short tousled hair, violet and gold robes white scarf. ROW4 NOAH: adult man age26 light lavender blue wavy hair tied back, teal green cloak gold embroidery, white shirt and bard lyre detail. In EACH ROW same individual repeated with COLUMN1 calm kind neutral expression, COLUMN2 joyful open smile, COLUMN3 determined serious expression. This is FOUR characters times THREE expressions; not twelve different characters. Keep each portrait scale, gaze and camera consistent. The three core characters are NOT children: existing small sprites are stylization only.
